intro.text: A set of laws governing how worldhoppers deal with one another.

description.text: The Codes are made up of bills, of which only one is known: the Refugee and Lost Expatriate Bill, under which individuals can request asylum at interplanetary facilities.

items.text: At a sealed door on Canticle, Nomad invoked an interplanetary bill to request asylum, and a voice inside offered to negotiate.
